## legacy / default (fixed pipeline)
nodes: __end__, __start__, critic, planner, reader, search, synthesizer
edges:
  __start__ -> planner
  critic -> __end__ [conditional]
  critic -> planner [conditional]
  critic -> search [conditional]
  critic -> synthesizer [conditional]
  planner -> search
  reader -> synthesizer
  search -> reader
  synthesizer -> critic

## legacy / supervisor loop
nodes: __end__, __start__, critic, planner, reader, search, supervisor, synthesizer
edges:
  __start__ -> supervisor
  critic -> supervisor
  planner -> supervisor
  reader -> supervisor
  search -> supervisor
  supervisor -> __end__ [conditional]
  supervisor -> critic [conditional]
  supervisor -> planner [conditional]
  supervisor -> reader [conditional]
  supervisor -> search [conditional]
  supervisor -> synthesizer [conditional]
  synthesizer -> supervisor

## legacy / supervisor loop + verifier + query refiner
nodes: __end__, __start__, critic, planner, query_refiner, reader, search, supervisor, synthesizer, verifier
edges:
  __start__ -> supervisor
  critic -> supervisor
  planner -> supervisor
  query_refiner -> supervisor
  reader -> supervisor
  search -> supervisor
  supervisor -> __end__ [conditional]
  supervisor -> critic [conditional]
  supervisor -> planner [conditional]
  supervisor -> query_refiner [conditional]
  supervisor -> reader [conditional]
  supervisor -> search [conditional]
  supervisor -> synthesizer [conditional]
  supervisor -> verifier [conditional]
  synthesizer -> supervisor
  verifier -> supervisor
